stem_book: The reversible expansion of an ideal gas under adiabatic and isothermal conditions is shown in the figure (w = work done by the gas). Which of the following statement(s) is (are) correct ? (a) T₁ = T₂ (b) ΔS_isothermal > ΔS_adiabatic (c) w_isothermal > w_adiabatic (d) All of these
key: D All of these You marked: C
reason: (c) is true only for work done BY the gas (area under curve); convention added to stem
work: isothermal ⇒ T₁ = T₂; ΔS_iso = nR ln(V₂/V₁) > 0 = ΔS_adi(rev); area under isotherm larger ⇒ w_iso > w_adi
